subject: Springboard co-hosted livestream + regional booth ops
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@springboard.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Springboard co-hosted livestream + popup booth idea

Hi Elena —

Great to meet last week on the partner call. Springboard's audience looks like a really strong fit for the kind of production-focused content we run. A quick proposal to move from conversation -> firm plan:

Proposal highlights
- 60-min co-hosted livestream: "Scaling LLM inference for production" (short product demo + partner spotlight + 10-min customer Q&A)
- Target date: windows in late July (our preference: Wed 28 July 10:00am PT)
- Regional popup/demo booth: co-branded presence at the NodeBound SF meetup (two-day on-site engagement) — proposed dates Aug 12–13
- MDF: we can co-fund booth + paid social. Suggest split 50/50 to start; will surface exact ask after we finalize scope.

We can provide: 2 field engineers for demo, a pre-built 15-min demo flow, and a landing page + RSVP funnel. Attaching a short promo outline and a proposed MDF CSV with ballpark numbers.

Can you confirm:
1) Interest in the proposed dates (livestream July 28 / booth Aug 12-13)?
2) Any contractual/PO process for MDF on your side?
3) Expected registrant targets for a co-hosted webinar and typical conversion to MQLs?

If we can lock dates and MDF intent by EOD next Tuesday (2026-06-16) we can reserve the event kit and a small paid social cadence.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake | Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: springboard-ma-promo-outline.pdf (1 page), proposed-mdf-commit.csv (spreadsheet)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@springboard.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@nodebound.co>
Date: 2026-06-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Springboard co-hosted livestream + popup booth idea

Thanks Jordan — this looks promising. Quick answers and a few asks: 

- Dates: July 28 for the livestream is doable. NodeBound SF on Aug 12–13 is tentatively free, will confirm by EOD Friday.
- Registrant expectations: for a co-hosted session like this we typically see 400–600 registrants and ~15% live attendance. Conversion to MQL varies; assume 6–9% with a strong CTA.
- MDF: we prefer an MDF + PO model rather than performance rebate. Our standard co-marketing terms are: list of deliverables (3 social posts, 1 joint email, 1 sponsored attendee list follow-up), logo use approval, and a Mutual Action Plan. MDF amounts are usually $5k–$15k depending on scope.

Would you be able to share a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a concise scope of work (deliverables + timeline)? Also: can Redwood provide a short speaker bio (100 words) and headshot by next Tue?

I can get Samir at NodeBound to confirm booth footprint and AV — looping him in.

— Elena
Elena Rossi | Head of Partnerships, Springboard.ai
Attachments: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Springboard co-hosted livestream + popup booth idea

Marissa / Laura — forwarding Elena's reply and the ask. Key items we need to close:

- Proposed MDF ask: the attached proposed-mdf-commit.csv shows $12,000 (split 50/50) covering booth share + small paid social push.
- Deliverables per Springboard: 3 social posts, 1 joint email, follow-up attendee list handling, MAP required.
- Dates: livestream target July 28; booth Aug 12–13 (Samir to confirm).

Marissa: can you review the attached budget and approve up to $12k MDF? If you prefer a smaller guaranteed commit we can make $2k contingent on registrant thresholds.

Laura: can you own booth logistics (staffing, local AV, shipping)? We can use Redwood roadshow kit but need your call on headcount and A/V.

Attached: mutual-action-plan-draft.docx, proposed-mdf-commit.csv

Thanks — I want to reply to Elena with firm dates and the MAP by Thursday if possible.

— Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Springboard co-hosted livestream + popup booth idea

Jordan —

Thanks for the context and the draft MAP. I can provisionally approve up to $10k MDF for this program. My preference: make $2k of the $12k contingent on meeting a 500-registrant threshold for the webinar (we can pay the remainder on PO).

Actions:
- Approve: $10,000 MDF (immediate)
- Contingent: $2,000 held until registrant threshold met (500)
- Creative: Karthik, please sync with Samir and Elena on co-branding specs; Laura, once you confirm staffing/AV costs we can finalize shipping line items.

Jordan — please update the MAP and send back to Elena with the updated MDF terms.

— Marissa

Elena / Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the plan below:

- Livestream: July 28, 2026 at 10:00am PT. 60-min co-hosted session (demo + panel).
- Popup Booth: Aug 12–13, 2026 at NodeBound SF. Co-branded 10x10 footprint, basic AV provided by NodeBound.
- MDF: Redwood will commit $10,000 upfront + $2,000 contingent on reaching 500 registrants for the webinar. We will issue PO for the $10k early next week; contingent $2k will be invoiced after registration threshold is validated.
- Deliverables requested from Springboard: 3 social posts, 1 joint email to your list, logo files (SVG + PNG), speaker bio (100 words) + headshot.
- Next steps: Elena — if these terms look good I will attach an updated MAP and send for signature. Samir — please confirm booth footprint (10x10) and pass any AV order link to Laura.

Attached: mutual-action-plan-draft.docx (updated with MDF terms). MAP link: https://drive.google.com/springboard-campaign-brief

Thanks — excited to run this together.
